description: At scale 0.5 (0.3 wide, 0.9 tall, eyes at 0.81): walking standing through a 1-high tunnel, up a slab onto a block, sneaking to its east edge (backed off at the narrower box's edge), down into a 1-deep pool whose surface is above the eyes, sprint-swimming in it and back; at 0.2 (eyes below 0.4) jumping in the pool, then on a waterlogged slab (0.39 of water over the feet) swimming up, and at 0.5 jumping from it; crouching in the tunnel at 0.5, set to 1 there (neither standing nor crouching fits: crawling) and crawling out; hopping on the slab with jump held, set to 0.5 and then 1.5 in mid-hop.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
